Case study · Health · Guides

PflegeOasis: care-level calculator, objection-letter generator and AI content with human review

A free portal that helps relatives find their way through the German care system – with calculators, checklists and more than 200 guide articles.

Role
Concept and sole development incl. operations
Status
MVP live
Stack
Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL 16, Drizzle ORM
AI & operations
OpenAI API (offline), GitHub Actions, PM2, Caddy, 1blu VPS
  • Next.js 15
  • PostgreSQL 16
  • Drizzle ORM
  • OpenAI
  • Human-in-the-Loop
  • CI/CD
  • PDF

The problem: care is a bureaucratic maze

Anyone who suddenly cares for a relative faces terms like Pflegegrad (care level), Pflegegeld (care allowance), assessment and objection. Good information exists, but it is scattered, written in legal language and often not tailored to the actual question.

The solution: tools, not just texts

  • Care-level calculator based on the points system of the assessment
  • Care-allowance calculator for quick orientation
  • Objection-letter generator that produces a ready-to-send letter as a PDF
  • Application checklist and 200+ guide articles on the most common questions

AI content with human-in-the-loop

With care law, mistakes are not acceptable. That is why the OpenAI API creates article drafts exclusively offline – never live for visitors. Every draft is generated with structured prompts, sources and legal bases and reviewed by a human before publication. The AI speeds up the work; responsibility stays with the human.

More: AI content with human-in-the-loop – the note.

Technology and operations

  • Next.js 15 (App Router) with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL 16 with Drizzle ORM
  • Calculator logic as separate, testable modules – not buried in the UI
  • PDF generation with react-pdf
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions → SSH → git pull, pnpm install, pnpm build, then pm2 reload without downtime; Caddy renews the TLS certificates automatically
  • Operated on my own 1blu VPS

Details: CI/CD for Next.js 15 on a VPS.

Note: PflegeOasis offers orientation, not legal advice. This page describes the project from a developer’s point of view.
